mode: real human controller, browser controls operated by agent; no HTTP gameplay driver

coverage_pilot: One unchanged realistic pilot must reach turn 12 before five fresh repetitions. No fixture substitutions in realistic runs. Stop on a new unsupported or ambiguous prompt.
workload: Fresh normal game, acknowledge authorized warning, keep recorded hand. metrics: Startup measured separately fresh-process/warm-or-unspecified-storage. Active memory sampled from segment-start marker to endpoint. reuse: Original idle/AI/lifecycle evidence remains historical; no full suite rerun. New adapter, UI and fixture hashes distinguish new measurements.
ordering_choice: Explicitly choose Sword of the Animist to resolve before Arahbo for simultaneous attack triggers; confirm/pay or decline optional effects intentionally as offered, no saved ordering.
endpoint: First human turn-12 priority prompt, after six CPU turns. No need to complete turn 12 or claim a natural game result.
performance: Keep 30 s startup and >=20% memory headroom targets. A completed workload may fail these. If 1 GiB completed workload fails memory criterion, one bounded 2 GiB comparison is allowed. No optimization loop.
active_window: Retain whole-process memory/CPU/ACK samples including opening. Derived active view window is CPU turn 3 UPKEEP through turn-12 endpoint or first failure. CPU-call nanoseconds not aligned to supervisor clock; report full-process method samples distinctly.
